title: ticket
description: One ticket file. A human and tool mirror of the ticket shape in docs/ticket-contract.md (eleven required keys, two optional plan link keys, the optional removed_tests); the crate does not interpret this file, and a later test pins its required set to the reader's.

repo_id.description: Which repository the ticket is for: a plain name, never a path, never '.' or '..'. Where the repository lives is not part of this file.

main_plan_ref.description: Optional. The plan index rows this ticket builds. Not beside off_plan.

off_plan.description: Optional. One line saying why the ticket is off plan. Not beside main_plan_ref.

removed_tests.description: Optional. Tests this ticket removes, each '<test id> -- <reason>' (split at the first ' -- '). A test id appears once. The engine hands the ids to head-only gate programs as HARNESS_GATE_REMOVED_TESTS.
